svg.text: Every shared-track cell is numbered with its absolute index 0–51. Lanes show seat steps 51–55; ● 56 is home.
↻ Clockwise route with one arrow per step. Solid outline = start (step 0, safe).
Gold ★ badge = safe cell (4 starts + 4 stars). Dashed outline = home entry (step 50).
Crimson: start r6c1 → entry r7c0 → lane r7c1–r7c5 → home
Royal Blue: start r1c8 → entry r0c7 → lane r1c7–r5c7 → home
Emerald: start r8c13 → entry r7c14 → lane r7c13–r7c9 → home
Golden Yellow: start r13c6 → entry r14c7 → lane r13c7–r9c7 → home
